description: Establish multi-git and multi-archive mirroring setup to prevent single-point-of-failure takedown requests. GitHub secrets and Codeberg mirroring are configured; GitLab direct git mirroring is blocked by the existing GitLab mirror repository's SHA-256 object format and now has explicit target-level readiness reporting, scheduled probe diagnostics, release-readiness gating, and a manual SHA-1 repair checklist.
